column1: # Real americanliterature.com book pages (the /books/ catalogue), unedited.
# The site's Cloudflare front refuses this sandbox outright and no dev-Worker
# token was available, so the bytes are Wayback Machine raw replays
# (web.archive.org/web/<ts>id_/<url>: the response exactly as the site sent
# it, no archive toolbar or rewriting), the capture nearest 2026-10-11.
# The site was redesigned in spring 2026; only pages on the current template
# (the #chapter-toc-list table of contents) were kept, and any block or
# archive-outage page was rejected. capture_url is the replay the bytes came
# from; app_url is the site's own address, which the app uses.
# Every book from /books/ with a current-template capture is here: 152, from
# 1 chapter to 181, with and without part/book section headings.
# The columns after them were measured by a separate bs4/lxml script, NOT
# this app's parser, so the tests cross-check rather than echo it:
#   completed  always true — the site prints no status; it is a library of
#              published books, none of them serialised.
#   chapters   distinct hrefs of the table of contents' chapter links, section
#   max_page   1 — no book's table of contents is paginated.
